subject: Request to pause scheduled retention purge during DPA amendment
messages:
From: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: please pause May 1 purge while DPA redlines are resolved

Hi Evelyn,

We just received word from our legal team that the DPA amendment we sent last week (attached) needs an additional round of review before we can sign. There is a scheduled backup and snapshot purge for Acme Health on 2027-05-01 that touches customer snapshots and some long-tail logs. Can Redwood pause the purge for Acme while we finalize the DPA redlines?

Specifically we need:
- A temporary hold on deletion of backups and snapshots containing Acme data for 60 days from 2027-05-01
- A log-ttl exception for event and audit logs covering the same period (approx. 90 days)
- Confirmation of what evidence Redwood can provide (audit trail, snapshot IDs, retention matrix)

I attached ACME-DPA-redlines.pdf and a spreadsheet with our asks. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sarah Lowe
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health

Attachment: ACME-DPA-redlines.pdf
Attachment: ACME-Retention-asks.xlsx

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: please pause May 1 purge while DPA redlines are resolved

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for sending the redlines + asks. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Karthik (infra).

High level response: we can provisionally pause the automated purge for Acme snapshots and delay lifecycle deletion for 60 days, subject to final DPA signatures and an agreed mutual action plan. For log-ttl exceptions we can extend retention for a limited window but need to confirm cost impact and the exact log buckets you need retained.

Can you confirm the following so infra can scope the work quickly:
- Exact project/environment IDs (or example snapshot IDs) to target
- Which log types (audit, request, application) and date ranges you need held
- Whether you need immutable escrow or just a temporary hold until signature

Kimberly — can you advise on legal guardrails for a conditional hold and any language we should put in the MAP?

Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: please pause May 1 purge while DPA redlines are resolved

Hi all — quick legal note: we can agree to a 60-day temporary pause tied to an executed mutual action plan (MAP). Suggested guardrails:

- Scope the pause to specified snapshot IDs, storage buckets, and log buckets listed in an annex (Acme to provide).
- Include acceptance criteria for evidence delivery (audit trail CSV + MD5s for snapshot manifests).
- Define automatic expiry: hold lapses after 60 days unless mutually extended in writing.
- Redwood will not provide indefinite escrow without a signed amendment to the DPA and subprocessor acknowledgment.

I've drafted a short MAP language and a retention matrix template — attaching Retention-Matrix-v2.xlsx for infra to map to systems. Laura, please coordinate CS for evidence upload if we move forward.

Kimberly Park
Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Retention-Matrix-v2.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: please pause May 1 purge while DPA redlines are resolved

Thanks — technical plan below. Short version: we can implement a targeted pause that will:

1) Flag the identified snapshot IDs (or environment tags) and exclude them from the automated lifecycle deletion job scheduled for 2027-05-01.
2) Retain associated incremental backups for the 60-day hold + keep relevant KV cache invalidation off.
3) Create a retention-evidence bundle with: snapshot manifest list, deletion-block flag audit log, and S3 object versions (where applicable).

Operational considerations and limits:
- We need Acme to provide either environment IDs or a list of representative snapshot IDs by 2027-04-26 to meet the 2027-05-01 job cutoff.
- Extending log-ttl across all audit buckets for 90 days will increase storage. Estimated incremental cost: ~$3,200/month (US region) based on current ingest and retention sizes. We can provide a breakdown if needed.
- For immutable escrow (WORM-style) we would require a change order and separate escrow SLA; that will take longer (2–3 weeks to provision and confirm).

If you approve, we will implement the exclusion flags and publish the retention evidence bundle to the shared drive link (see related_links).

Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: please pause May 1 purge while DPA redlines are resolved

Evelyn / team — thank you, this is helpful. Attached is ACME-Retention-asks.xlsx with the specific buckets and a handful of snapshot IDs. We accept the 60-day temporary pause (no immutable escrow at this time) and request the 90-day log-ttl exception limited to audit + security logs.

We also need a MAP and a DocuSign to sign. Please send the MAP and a link to the DocuSign when ready. Per procurement policy, we need the cost impact callout in writing.

Best,
Sarah Lowe
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health

Attachment: ACME-Retention-asks.xlsx

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: please pause May 1 purge while DPA redlines are resolved

Sarah — confirmed. Summary and next steps:

- Agreement: Redwood will implement a targeted 60-day pause on snapshot and backup deletion for the IDs listed in ACME-Retention-asks.xlsx. The hold window: 2027-05-01 through 2027-06-30 inclusive, unless extended in writing.
- Logs: Redwood will extend TTL for audit + security logs for 90 days (2027-05-01 through 2027-07-30). Estimated incremental cost: $3,200/month (US). We'll include the cost callout in the MAP.
- Deliverables: retention evidence bundle (snapshot manifests + deletion-block audit) uploaded to the shared drive by 2027-05-03.
- Action items:
  * Acme: provide final snapshot IDs / env IDs by 2027-04-26 (Sarah)
  * Redwood Infra: set exclusion flags by 2027-04-29 (Karthik)
  * Redwood Legal: prepare MAP and DocuSign by 2027-04-30 (Kimberly)
  * Redwood CS: prepare evidence upload and monitor (Laura)

I am attaching the draft MAP (MutualActionPlan-Redwood-Acme.docx) for your review; I will route the DocuSign link once the MAP is final. If Acme confirms the IDs by the 26th we'll be on track to avoid the purge.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MutualActionPlan-Redwood-Acme.docx
